jobs.description: ESG Strategy | Candex Sustainable Procurement Close Allow Candex Uses Cookies To improve experience Allow Learn More Email Password Stay signed In Forgot your password? Continue Email Request Password Back to Login  How it Works For Buyers For Sellers About About Us Pricing Careers Media Sign In Sign In Candex Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) at Candex Candex’s ESG Approach At Candex, we enable corporate partners of all sizes to engage and transact quickly, seamlessly, and securely. We are driven by a commitment to not only increase the speed and efficiency of corporate engagements, but to do so in a way that promotes sustainability, inclusiveness, and compliance. We demonstrate these values in our corporate structure and initiatives, and through our client offerings. Frameworks & Assessments We leverage reporting frameworks, such as GHG Protocol and United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and engage with third-party assessment platforms, including EcoVadis and CDP, to ensure our ESG efforts are measurable and effective. These frameworks and assessments help us integrate ESG strategies into our operations, enhancing our accountability and positioning us as proactive participants in the global sustainability movement. This is reflected in our most recent EcoVadis Silver and SME B CDP ratings. Environment As a streamlined, digital company, Candex is able to strategically limit our use of non-renewable resources and our carbon footprint. Though we operate globally, we limit our office space and travel, leveraging technology and a digital workspace to minimize our carbon footprint. We host the full Candex Platform on cloud-based server space. We proactively identified providers who are focused on leveraging renewable sources of energy and are carbon neutral, with plans to be net-zero in the identifiable future. In addition, our primary server partner powers the cloud servers we use entirely with renewable energy. But sustainability is not just about carbon emissions. It is also about addressing resource depletion, preserving biodiversity, and limiting pollution. Candex was founded with a digital-first philosophy. This extends not only to our SaaS application, but also to the way we operate our business, which includes eliminating needless use of paper and other resources through entirely electronic purchase order submission and invoicing. In our own workspaces, we promote recycling and reduce waste, including reusing and recycling all products whenever possible, including technology, equipment, and office waste. Social At Candex, our employees are central to our success. We take a firm non-discrimination stance in order to attract and retain top talent. We are committed to providing a safe, healthy, inclusive, and respectful work environment for all team members, regardless of race, religion, creed, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability. From individual contributors to executive leadership and our Board of Directors, the Candex team includes representation from various gender, ethnic, racial, and geographic groups. Gender Equity 62%+ Female Employees 57% at executive level Multi-national Team 15 Countries around the Globe represented We believe that our success and innovation is driven by investing in our people and creating spaces for collaborative learning and personal development. Through our annual Employee Satisfaction Survey, we actively listen to and learn from our employees and incorporate their ideas and feedback into our activities, policies, and processes. We strive to create a working environment and provide facilities and resources that enable every employee to feel safe at work in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. To promote health and safety at Candex offices, we maintain comprehensive security policies and procedures, including physical security infrastructure, to keep our employees safe, and our customer data secure. Governance & Ethics We recognize the importance of living our values at all levels of the organization, and therefore set a tone of ethics and compliance at the top with executive leadership and our Board of Directors. Our independent Board of Directors elects corporate officers, advises the executive leadership team, and provides strategic oversight while monitoring Candex’s performance. The Board provides guidance and counsel to our Chief Executive Officer and oversees our programs and services to prevent and detect violations of law, regulation, or our internal policies and procedures. To this end, each Candex quarterly Board meeting allocates time for compliance reviews. With Board oversight, our executive leadership team has built a robust compliance infrastructure to support our culture of integrity and accountability. We maintain and perform company-wide annual training on our compliance policies, including Code of Conduct, Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Fraud , and Anti-Corruption. Among other things, our Code of Conduct sets out clear guidelines around conflicts of interest, confidentiality and privacy, gifts and entertainment, compliance reporting, and non-retaliation. Data Privacy & Information Security We have invested significant resources in a best-in-class information security and data privacy team and framework, led by our CISO and Global Data Protection Officer. Our robust programs are confirmed by our SOC 2 Type II attestation and ISO 27001 certification maintenance. Candex has implemented a robust and comprehensive global privacy program based on the principles of privacy by design, accountability, and transparency. We regularly assess and update our program to meet the requirements of emerging privacy laws and regulations across the world, as well as to keep up with rapid advancements in technology and new business initiatives. Recognized in the ProcureTech 100 for Procurement Innovation, our SaaS Platform and accompanying services completely transform the buying experience for large companies around the globe. Available in almost 50 countries, Candex is expanding our already robust footprint and is looking for ambitious, fun people to join us on our mission to revolutionize the way businesses engage and pay their suppliers. This position will be instrumental in developing new products and capabilities on our platform for our clients. Responsibilities - Collaborate closely with Product and Design teams to build new features end-to-end. - Coordinate with engineering and product leadership to define projects that help us meet business objectives. - Support existing platforms including: additions to features, upgrade of technology and implementation of new clients’ requests. - Work with support to investigate and debug technical support requests and client issues. - Work in an Agile environment, at a sustainable pace of one/two-week sprints. - Continuously learn and evaluate new technologies and guide team decision making. - Mentor, pair, and delegate work to encourage the professional and technical growth of peers. Qualifications - 6+ years of experience developing production web applications preferably in Microsoft stack - BSc/BA in Computer Science or equivalent military background - Deep knowledge in software architecture design - Deep knowledge in either Client side or Server side - Experience with SQL, general database knowledge - Great analytical and troubleshooting skills - Motivated, energetic and ambitious team player - Passionate for code quality, testing and performance - FinTech background - advantage - Experience with AWS technologies - advantage - Experience with Testing Frameworks - advantage Our Technologies AWS, .Net Core, C#, ASP.NET MVC, windows services, SQL server, JavaScript, backbone.js, marionette, jQuery, webpack, Sass. Why Work With Us - We are humble, hungry, intelligent and collaborative. Work alongside teammates who value curiosity, kindness, and shared success. - Competitive Compensation – Earn a salary and benefits that reflect your skills and impact. - Parental Leave – Take meaningful time to bond with your growing family. - Flexible Work Environment – Balance life and work with adaptable schedules. - Global Team + Mindset – Join a diverse, international team that thinks beyond borders. - Tech Setup – Get the gear and support you need to work comfortably. - Professional Development – Grow your skills with training and learning sessions. - Internal Mobility – Explore new global roles and career paths without leaving the company. - Team Outings – Connect and celebrate with colleagues through regular social events.
